claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Iopanoic acid is a cholecystographic contrast agent and deiodinase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells through its annotated thyroid-hormone-related mechanism; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect nonspecific physicochemical/cytotoxic stress rather than a targeted mechanism.
